cases.title: Panel: Show me again explains the change already made with a frame, and makes no second demonstration

rubric.reason: Turn 5 runs preview_frame without changing anything, explains only the one change already made ("Tab's pivot moved to the middle of its left edge, and Tab stayed where it was") with no values or field names, and hands Door back in one sentence.

Every name used (Door, Tab, middle of the left edge, center, Anchor Point, Position) matches the snapshot, demo and preview results, and Turn 4's "Tab's edges in the same place" follows from the identical layer_bounds before and after.

Each turn is short and moves one idea: Turn 1 ends on the choice, Turn 2 ends on the ask to press A then Shift+P, Turns 3 to 5 each end with one pending action, and there is no lecture or extra stage.

Turn 5 runs preview_frame without making any change, then says only that 'I moved Tab's pivot to the middle of its left edge, and Tab stayed exactly where it was', with no values or field names and no second demo, and ends by handing Door back ('say done when its pivot is on the middle of its left edge').

Door, Tab, their middle-left places and 'center' as the pivot now all come from anchor_snapshot, and Turn 4's 'its edges are in exactly the same place' matches the identical layer_bounds in the before and after preview_frame results.

Each turn is short and moves one idea: the opening asks the intent question and ends on the Door proposal, Turn 2 ends on the ask to press A then Shift+P with only the one pivot sentence, Turns 3 to 5 each end on a single pending action, and the frame-size aside in Turn 4 is not counted against it.

In Turn 5 the mentor ran preview_frame without making any change, explained the one change it had made ('Tab's pivot moved to the middle of its left edge, and Tab itself didn't move') with no values, and handed back with 'Now Door's yours: say done…'; the blank frame is not held against it.
Every layer and place named (Door, Tab, centers, middle of the left edge) comes from the snapshot's focus, places and place_now and from the anchor_demo result, and no time is invented.

Each turn moves one idea and ends on an action or a choice: the opening ends on 'Want to try that one?', Turn 2 on the A then Shift+P ask, Turn 3 on 'tell me when both show', Turn 4 reports the demo and hands Door over with the not-yet-given Pan Behind step, and Turn 5 ends on 'say done'.
